io.unit: Application-level operation byte budgets, not measured backend NFS traffic.
io.optimized_status: PROPOSAL_REQUIRES_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_CPU_NEGATIVE_TEST_REVIEW; current pilot script still hashes reused tensors per writer and cold-loads each variant.
io.reuse_prior_hash_scope: Frozen fresh-SHA ledger + exact current stable fingerprint+manifest before/after gates for nonrepresentative originals; changed inputs stop only that group and require newly budgeted full rehash. Never treat blob SHA as old archive SHA.
io.budget_components: One bounded streaming archive read into RAM computes complete SHA; torch.load reads the same BytesIO RAM buffer, so no second NFS source read. Buffer released after load. Plus at most one existing-blob verification read, one unique blob write, and one group-cold full blob read. Existing and missing blob sets are disjoint, so the full read+write allowance is conservative. Source/manifest fingerprints before/after; nonrepresentative files reuse frozen all49 fresh SHA proof only while all stable identities match.
io.cpu_time_note: Additional CPU constructor/probe time not measured for all49. G14 1.154GB representative publication153s and each four-probe cold about70s. Largest9.478GB scenes cannot be assigned a reliable total runtime from two pilot scenes; quote IO floor separately and revise after first large group.

contract_matrix.coverage: All same key schema and evidence kinds as G01. Missing only native_mode_rule and semantic_measure_rule; fixed-none migration contract covered. Three distinct effective specs/state identities, separate original provenance and manifest bindings.
Same schema as G14; missing semantic_measure_rule only. mean/measure remain distinct identities; measure_native and measure_resized are separate query-input modes bound in consumer identity.

Nine early groups need narrowly enumerated constructor-default migration contract for missing spatial_metric/world_units_per_metre/local_metric/support_aggregation/negative_rule as applicable. Existing expected_energy, competitive_* and native_cosine values must remain unchanged. G47 already has full spec but native-region v1/v2 scientific runtime/consumer bindings need separate review. No assumption same archive implies same function. Identical state+effective spec may share state_identity, but per-origin manifest/method provenance must remain independently bound.

still_required: Build explicit old_path + oldarchiveSHA + oldmanifestSHA -> new package + historical/effective spec identities + method/code/queryconfig + store mapping per frozen cohort/design.
Current generic consumer_overlay is an identity mapping, not an automatic interceptor for legacy paths or a rebuilt full nine-scene native design.
Verify native_mode rule plus resized/native query input arm separately; score barrier/cache keys must reject old receipt under new mapping.

Inventory downstream parent compile/resume/direct torch.load references for each batch; migrate those readers or provide bounded explicit v1 export with its own byte-identity proof if archive SHA is enforced.
Protected-native next20 runtime overlay is a separate unapproved retirement chain and cannot be counted here.
consumer_admission.retirement_gate: No originals eligible for automatic deletion. After exact state/spec/cold and every active consumer or bounded legacy replay path is accepted, prepare one exact per-batch user-confirmation list. Keep all original manifest/config/receipts.

implementation_gates: Use verified typed rawstate once/group; instantiate each variant with its own historical/effective spec. Never clone a parent state_identity.

Introduce narrowly scoped validated-state/descriptor reuse within one immutable stage only; before/after fingerprint excludes only allocated. Hash bytes once per stage and fail on any other identity change.

Group cold runs in a fresh process with audited old-source open denial, actively tested. Verify every variant manifest and old/effective identity; raw tensor descriptors checked before/after each variant probe; all query outputs exact.

Proof tests: mixed specs, identical specs with separate provenance, dtype preservation, missing/corrupt blob, wrong store/oldarchive identity, stale cache/partial receipts, source changed, typed defaults and allocation-only drift.
Publish once with no replace, record blob intents and per-variant receipts; on failure retain partials, skip accepted groups, resume only through reviewed new attempt path and cumulative budget.
Prohibit whole-package hardlinks, lossy FP conversion, dropping raw tensors, or data-dependent changes in scientific thresholds.

One archive read uses capped BytesIO + streaming SHA before trusted weights_only load; enough RAM for archive plus raw tensors and one field at a time. No unbounded temporary disk copy; no GPU. Buffer/field lifecycle measured by RSS.

resources.group_ram_gate: At least max(96GiB, 5*representative_tensor_bytes + 16GiB), adapt only after actual RSS evidence.
resources.temp_peak: No second full archive export by default; source originals remain until explicit retirement. New unique CAS budget+256MiB metadata, 25% allocated margin; any explicit legacy export adds up to9.478GB on its selected filesystem and is separately retained/approved for cleanup.

independent_process_boundaries.publication: One fresh bounded CPU process per group; one source read/load. Each variant constructed under its original historical spec with historical loader defaults, dtype/value exact check, typed effective-spec contract, and CPU semantic probes. Save distinct manifests/provenance; scientific operations unchanged.
independent_process_boundaries.cold: A different fresh process for the group, started after publication. Actual audit hook denies all six old output trees and source root, active negative opens first. Unique blobs SHA-verified once into a bounded stage-local immutable tensor map. Every variant gets an independently checked manifest/spec/method binding and freshly constructed field, per-variant exact state/spec + query output comparison. Clear field between variants, hash in-memory state before/after probes, prohibit cross-group cache.
independent_process_boundaries.not_required: A separate OS process for every same-state variant is not necessary if the separate cold group process has no source handles/state and every variant is constructed and checked independently. Existing pilot per-variant independent processes remain stronger evidence, not silently relabeled as a group-cache implementation.
